numeric_cast: float32 inside fitted pipeline, after median imputation

calibration.selection: Use sigmoid if honest outer-OOF Brier is strictly lower than raw OOF Brier; otherwise keep raw
calibration.scope: Winner only, after base candidate selection; train data only

threshold: Use protocol validation-only cost and tie-break, then freeze before internal test
convergence_policy: Record warnings and iteration count; do not silently accept a nonconverged LR as eligible
execution: Sequential fits, n_jobs=1; per-fold CSV and OOF checkpoints for resumption
